answer: Every identity posts a bond before its first submission, and the bond is voided when the jury grading it shares an operator or a subnet. Panel diversity is checked by comparing declared egress ranges, not by trusting labels. Because duplicates are caught by replaying the ledger hash, a fable of copy-paste accounts still needs its own bond and its own diverse jury. Forty fakes means forty bonds and forty panels drawn from pools the operator does not control, the velvet margins of cheap registration disappear, and the horizon of that cost shows before any first reward.
